headline: Milwaukee Rockets From 26% to 67%
caption:
Three weeks, one title race, totally redrawn.

On Sep 27 our model gave MIL a 26% chance to win the World Series. Now it's 67% (peak: 69%), the biggest climb on the board at +41 points. TB nearly matched the story, going from 10% to 33%.

LAD took the hardest fall: 24% at the start, as high as 37%, now 0%. Our model simulates the rest of the season and the playoffs thousands of times each day, so every swing is a reaction to real results. And 67% isn't a lock; TB wins this about 1 time in 3.

Bigger story: Milwaukee's climb or the Dodgers' drop?
